paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: : Tradeoff between and for different parameter combinations. We annotate each data point with its corresponding value.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the tradeoff between IDK recall (y-axis) and IDK error rate (x-axis) for four different experimental configurations, as indicated by the legend: “No ℒFP-reg, fixed λ” (blue line with x markers), “No ℒFP-reg, adaptive λ” (green dashed line with triangle markers), “With ℒFP-reg, fixed λ” (orange line with x markers), and “With ℒFP-reg, adaptive λ” (red dashed line with triangle markers). The x-axis, labeled “IDK error rate,” spans from 0 to 0.25 with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The y-axis, labeled “IDK recall,” ranges from 0.1 to 0.7 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Each data point is annotated with its corresponding λ value. The blue line starts at approximately (0.025, 0.1) and rises steadily to (0.25, 0.65). The green dashed line begins at (0.05, 0.2) and increases to (0.2, 0.6). The orange line starts at (0.025, 0.1) and climbs to (0.15, 0.6), with λ values increasing from 0.1 to 0.5 along the curve. The red dashed line begins at (0.025, 0.2) and rises sharply to (0.075, 0.65), with λ values from 0.2 to 0.5. All lines show a positive trend, indicating that higher IDK error rates generally correspond to higher IDK recall across all configurations.
